environment: Windows, Node 22.15, Next.js production server, loopback, connected Supabase database, unthrottled
method: Sum gzipSync sizes of HTML script src resources, excluding nomodule-only scripts. This is a compressed transfer-size estimate, not a browser execution or field metric.
limitations: Lab LCP/CLS are not real-user 75th-percentile measurements. INP and field Core Web Vitals remain unavailable without real traffic.
Local serving omits deployed CDN/hosting latency and cannot establish WCAG conformance.
The 26-route SEO audit is separate; Lighthouse category scores here apply only to the homepage.
Only default-hero assets are measured; remeasure after selecting other hero/media, analytics, ads or integrations.
